name: Elune's Grace
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
You know you have access to any of our trainers at any time, adventurer, but there are some things that we cannot pass on to you. One of those things are the teachings of your goddess Elune. She gives special abilities to her faithful, and if I'm not mistaken, it is time for you to return home to your Temple of the Moon to be tested.

Return there when you can and speak to Priestess Alathea.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText: Elune bless you for returning so quickly to us. This is an important time in your training, and a time that all of our order take very seriously. When you've rested from your journey here, please, let me know. We can then discuss the continuation of your training and where your path will lead you next.
